name: Independent Contractor Agreement
description: An agreement engaging a self-employed individual or entity to perform specific work, clearly distinguishing them from an employee.

fields.name: contract_duration
fields.label: Contract Duration (e.g. 6 months, until project completion)

content:
INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT

This Independent Contractor Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{effective_date}} between:

{{company_name}}, located at {{company_address}} ("Company"),

and

{{contractor_name}}, located at {{contractor_address}} ("Contractor").

1. ENGAGEMENT
The Company engages the Contractor to perform the following services ("Services") on an independent contractor basis:

{{scope_of_work}}

2. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR STATUS
The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, agent, partner, or joint venturer of the Company. The Contractor shall:
a) Have sole control over the manner and means of performing the Services;
b) Be solely responsible for all taxes, including income tax, self-employment tax, and VAT/GST where applicable;
c) Not be entitled to any employee benefits, including health insurance, paid leave, or pension contributions;
d) Provide their own equipment and tools unless otherwise agreed in writing.

3. TERM
This Agreement commences on {{effective_date}} and continues for {{contract_duration}}, unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement.

4. COMPENSATION
The Company shall pay the Contractor at a rate of {{rate_amount}} {{rate_currency}} per {{rate_type}}. Payment shall be made within {{payment_terms_days}} days of receipt of a valid invoice.

5. EXPENSES
The Contractor shall be responsible for all expenses incurred in connection with the Services, unless pre-approved in writing by the Company.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All work product, inventions, developments, and deliverables created by the Contractor in the course of performing Services under this Agreement shall be considered works made for hire and shall be the sole property of the Company. Where such work cannot legally be a work made for hire, the Contractor hereby assigns all rights, title, and interest therein to the Company.

7. CONFIDENTIALITY
The Contractor shall not, during or after the term of this Agreement, disclose any confidential information of the Company to any third party, or use such information for any purpose other than performing the Services.

8. NON-COMPETE
For a period of {{non_compete_months}} month(s) following termination of this Agreement, the Contractor shall not engage in or provide services to any business that directly competes with the Company within the same market.

9. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
The Contractor represents and warrants that:
a) They have the right to enter into this Agreement;
b) The Services and deliverables will not infringe any third-party intellectual property rights;
c) They will perform the Services in a professional manner consistent with industry standards.

10. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this Agreement with 14 days' written notice. The Company may terminate immediately for cause, including material breach or misconduct. Upon termination, the Contractor shall be paid for all approved work completed prior to termination.

11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. The Company's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid to the Contractor in the preceding three months.

12. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of {{governing_law_state}}.

13. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

_______________________________
For and on behalf of {{company_name}}
Date: _______________

_______________________________
{{contractor_name}}
Contractor
Date: _______________
